messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Can't Generate Suvery Report
parts:
Hi Bazilah,
it seems that there is a mismatch between the station IDs in your camera trap table and the station IDs in the record table. 

See this post and the code there:

# show all unique entries of the record table station column that are not in the camera trap station table
unique(rec.table60$Station)[!unique(rec.table60$Station) %in% cams$Station]

# show all unique entries of the camera trap station table station column that are not in record table
unique(cams$Station)[!unique(cams$Station) %in% unique(rec.table60$Station)]

If these lines returns station IDs that are not matched, correct them, then rerun your code. 
If that does not help, please let us know.
Best,
Jürgen
